mapper.select: SELECT USERID ,USERPASS ,BUSEO ,GRADE ,POSITION ,NAME FROM SAWON_MST A WHERE 1=1 AND TOISA = '' AND USERID != '' AND A.USERID = #{SID} AND A.USERPASS = #{SPASS}
SELECT CUSTCD ,CUSTNAME ,OWNER ,SANO ,TELNO ,SOADDR + SUBADDR CUADDR ,PRICEWAY FROM USER_MST WHERE CUSTCD = #{BUSEO}

SELECT P.GUBUN,P.PROGRAM,P.PROGNAME,P.PROGKIND,P.PARM,P.COMPANY FROM PROG_INFO P, USER_PROG U WHERE P.PROGID = U.PROGID AND U.USERID = 'polsse' AND P.GUBUN != '' AND P.PROGKIND = #{PROGKIND} ORDER BY P.NEWID
SELECT PROGRAM ,NAME ,GUBUN ,CHK ,WEBID FROM PROG_INFO WHERE GRADE > 0 and GUBUN != '' ORDER BY GUBUN

SELECT CUST_MST.SABUNNM, CUST_MST.CUSTNAME, CUST_MST.TELNO, MEMO_TBL.CUSTCD, MEMO_TBL.SEQ, MEMO_TBL.MEMO, MEMO_TBL.PRDATE, MEMO_TBL.PRTIME, MEMO_TBL.GUBUN, MEMO_TBL.STAT, MEMO_TBL.PLANDATE, MEMO_TBL.OKDATE, MEMO_TBL.OKID FROM MEMO_TBL ,CUST_MST WHERE MEMO_TBL.CUSTCD = CUST_MST.CUSTCD AND MEMO_TBL.STAT LIKE '' AND MEMO_TBL.PLANDATE != '' ORDER BY MEMO_TBL.PLANDATE,CUST_MST.CUSTNAME ASC

SELECT CDATE,SUM(AMT) AMT,SUM(BANPUM) BANPUM,SUM(SKAMT) SKAMT,SUM(SALEAMT) SALEAMT,SUM(INAMT) INAMT,SUM(KJAMT) KJAMT FROM ( SELECT CDATE, SUM(AMT) AMT, SUM(BANPUM) BANPUM,0 SKAMT,0 SALEAMT ,0 INAMT,0 KJAMT FROM MC20_MST WHERE MC20_MST.BUSEO = '0001' AND MC20_MST.CDATE BETWEEN DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -40 ,'YYYYMM00') AND DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD') GROUP BY CDATE UNION ALL SELECT KJSKDATE, 0, 0, SUM(CASHAMT), SUM(SALEAMT + BIAMT), 0, 0 FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND KJSKDATE BETWEEN DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -40 ,'YYYYMM00') AND DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD') AND KJSKGU = '수금' GROUP BY KJSKDATE UNION ALL SELECT IPDATE, 0, 0, 0,0, SUM(AMT - BANPUM), 0 FROM IP01_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND IP01_MST.IPDATE BETWEEN DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -40 ,'YYYYMM00') AND DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD') AND GUBUN = '매입' GROUP BY IPDATE UNION ALL SELECT KJSKDATE, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, SUM(CASHAMT - SALEAMT - BIAMT) FROM KJSK_MST WHERE BUSEO = '0001' AND KJSKDATE BETWEEN DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -40 ,'YYYYMM00') AND DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() ,'YYYYMMDD') AND KJSKGU = '결재' GROUP BY KJSKDATE ) AS T GROUP BY CDATE ORDER BY CDATE
